description: Lists the app in the public gallery. Fields: title and description per language (at least one language; `defaultLang` is the language they are written in), section ("multiplayer": users interact in real time; "singleplayer": one person at a time; "app": everything else), tags, devices ("mobile", "desktop", or omitted for both), and a cover image (an http(s) URL, a data: URI or raw base64 JPEG/PNG, scaled to 400x400). The app is listed only for visitors whose language is one of those given (en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ja, ko, zh, ar — the languages of the Neblla website and gallery; they limit only the listing, never the app, which can use any language), and nothing is translated automatically. Titles and descriptions each need at least one entry in the same language.

avatar.description: The "compatible with Mundo" seal (mundo chapter): true when the app shows each player the doll of their Neblla account with neblla.avatar.get() or neblla.avatar.doll(). Checked against pro's code: refused with avatar_not_used when it never calls them. The gallery filters by it («your doll is in it»). Omit to keep it as it is; false removes it.

bestOn.description: Device the app is best suited for. Omit for both mobile and desktop.

descriptions.description: Description per language code (max 500 chars each). At least one entry required.

portrait.description: Cover image. Accepts an http(s) URL, a data: URI, or raw base64 (JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP/TIFF). Auto-scaled to 400x400 JPEG, stored as portrait.jpg, and set as cover_image.

sandbox.description: Mundo's sandbox (mundo chapter, "Powers"): true when the powers of the things a person wears from Neblla's store (speed, jump, fly) count in this game; without it they are only looks. All or nothing; each room can turn it off with rooms.book({ config: { sandbox: false } }). Needs the world module (else world_off). The gallery shows it. Omit to keep it as it is; false removes it.

section.description: Gallery section: "multiplayer" (real-time/social), "singleplayer" (one person at a time), or "app" (utilities/tools/sites)

titles.description: Title per language code, e.g. { en: "My App", es: "Mi App" }. At least one entry required.

name: neblla_publish_app
